facts.fact: The Central Statistical Office's 2022 report states that the civil registration officer fills the birth or death form by hand and a typist then enters it into the National Population Register, the registration being complete only once it is in the system; the register sits on a mainframe at the national data centre, reached from Home Affairs headquarters and the civil registration service centres over a wide-area network.

The report states that births and deaths (and marriages and divorces) are captured into the National Population Register on registration, and counts 47,524 birth and 5,968 death registrations made in 2022, on Ministry of Home Affairs data.

The report's Table 3.1, sourced to the Ministry of Home Affairs, lists 14 civil registration service centres with births and deaths registered in the National Population Register in 2022, and says the register's application software is installed in all civil registration centres; it gives no separate total of offices.

The report states that the Civil Registration Department of the Ministry of Home Affairs manages the civil registration system, and that the register was developed in-house with, and is hosted, maintained and supported by, the government's Royal Science and Technology Park National Data Centre.
The report lists the development and launch of the CRVS Strategic Plan 2022-26 among the interventions of 2022; it does not say whether the plan names the register.
